mappings.basis: Unit 1 'Residents may enter the lantern lottery.' (evidence 0-44, overlapping the target quote 15-44) asserts that entry to the lottery is permitted, which is T1; naming residents as the actor folds the RESTRICT scope into the assertion but a reader still takes it as making the target's assertion (M3).

mapping_doubts.note: Narrower than the target: the unit folds the 'Only residents' restriction into the assertion as its subject. Mapped direct under M3; the 'only' exclusivity itself is not asserted by the unit text and is left to mechanical condition scoring.
